article.title: Aizuchi そうですね/はい/ええ
article.part: Partículas y relaciones — 助詞と関係
article.chapter: Objeto y partículas centrales: を/に/で/へ — 目的語と主要助詞：を／に／で／へ

claims.summary: Wakatsuki and Enomoto classify backchannels into response and emotional interjections, lexical responses, assessments, repetitions, and collaborative completions; their study examines six participants in a 31:21 pizza-making video and reports how participation roles relate to these response types.

locator.description: Proceedings paper, pp. 15–20: abstract and sections 1–4; taxonomy of back-channel types, examples of response interjections (はい／ええ) and lexical responses (そうですね), study data and role-dependent results.
